rule: B6 scene-name parsing — the model's reply for a scene TYPE, cleaned into a title
why: Both ends run the same SCENE prompt and must land on the same name. The cases marked source=e2b-probe are verbatim on-device replies; they are the reason the parser strips emoji at all.
note: `expected: null` means the reply is unnameable and the caller keeps the bare scene_label as the title. Consumed by core/tests/test_episodic_title_scene.py; the Android JUnit suite still carries its own copy of these cases (SceneNamingTest.kt) — wiring it to read this file needs a Gradle sourceSets change and a device run.

cases.note: first non-empty line wins, reasoning below is dropped
source=e2b-probe — the on-device model decorates roughly half its names
an emoji-only reply leaves nothing nameable

cases.input: 这家店让我想起了很多很多温暖的回忆和故事
cases.expected: 这家店让我想起了很多很多
cases.note: a rambling answer is capped at 12 CHARACTERS, not dropped — CJK has no spaces to count
